context:
Goal: keep the global CLAUDE.md small, with each rule loading where it must act.
Problem (rule): the audit moves two parts of the Git section into skills, and nothing moves without your sign-off.
Based on (ruling): your 12:38 and 12:40 CST Nov 11 words on moving sections, "it would need my sign off".
Based on (measured): the plan's word counts, and its load test: a rule that stops an act must load before that act.
Departs from: main — the record id and file rules (74 words) move to skill fresh-prose (rules for docs and records), and the batch steps (102 words) stay only in skill ci-hygiene (CI upkeep and batching), with the rule line kept global.
Meanwhile: nothing moves before your answer; the guard test file split this waited on is done (merged 07:16 CST Nov 12).
Re-checked 11:39 CST Nov 12: the quoted text is unchanged. Correction: the gain is about 74 words, not 176; the batch rule is already one short line pointing at the CI upkeep skill (ci-hygiene), so nothing is left to move there. "Name a lane by its branch slug" acts when naming lanes, which the record-writing skill (fresh-prose) does not cover.

options.gain: About 176 words leave the global file.
options.how: The lane moves the text as the plan proposes.
options.label: Accept the moves
options.lose: The record rules load only when skill fresh-prose (rules for docs and records) fires.

options.gain: The rule loads in every session, before any act.
options.label: Keep it global
options.lose: No words leave the global file.

reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: the moves are accepted. Sent to lane global-claude-md-scope-audit.
short: Git: move record and batch rules?
title: Where parts of the Git section of CLAUDE.md live
why: The lane's pick: both parts act only when their skill already fires.
